beats.what: Now forecast as a very severe cyclone. Landfall likely between Machilipatnam and Visakhapatnam on Oct 28, winds up to 140 kmph. Telangana feels it on Oct 28, mainly in the east and northeast.
beats.why: Andhra is evacuating low-lying areas from Bapatla to Vizianagaram; Tamil Nadu and Puducherry have hoisted cyclone warning signals at 9 ports; Odisha has activated disaster teams. For drought-hit Telangana, the rain is also a ray of hope.
beats.care: In Warangal, Hanumakonda, Khammam or Kothagudem? Plan around Oct 28. Hyderabad: carry an umbrella on Oct 28.

cards.body: Red alert (heavy to very heavy, isolated extremely heavy): Mulugu, Bhadradri Kothagudem, Khammam. Orange: Jayashankar Bhupalpally, Mahabubabad, Warangal, Hanumakonda, Suryapet. Yellow: Mancherial, Rajanna Sircilla, Karimnagar, Peddapalli, Jangaon, Nalgonda, Siddipet, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri. Thunderstorms and gusty winds likely.

cards.title: what changed (Oct 25, latest)
cards.body: 1) Andhra now braces for a VERY severe cyclone, a step above 'severe'. 2) APSDMA MD Prakhar Jain: landfall likely between Machilipatnam and Visakhapatnam on Oct 28, winds up to 140 kmph. 3) People in coastal districts to be evacuated; Chittoor and Annamayya districts also on alert. 4) Earlier today: depression formed, cyclone signals at 9 Tamil Nadu and Puducherry ports.

Hyderabad city has no IMD alert: light rain or thundershowers on Wed, Oct 28 (Siasat, Oct 25 evening). Private forecaster T Balaji expects light to moderate rain in Hyderabad from Oct 29 to Nov 4, and a crossing between Perupalem and Konaseema. That's his forecast, not IMD's.

cards.q: Cyclone week. Are you changing any plans?
How many Telangana districts are on some IMD alert for Oct 28?
cards.why: 3 red, 5 orange and 8 yellow (IMD via The Hindu, Oct 25).

hook: Upgraded to *very severe*: 140 kmph winds at Andhra landfall Oct 28, 16 Telangana districts on alert

learn.t: Cyclone names come from a list made by 13 countries around the Indian Ocean and are used in order. A storm is named only when its winds reach cyclonic strength (63 km/h or more).

tldr: Update: Andhra is now bracing for a very severe cyclone. APSDMA MD Prakhar Jain says landfall is likely between Machilipatnam and Visakhapatnam on Oct 28, with winds up to 140 kmph; coastal districts will be evacuated, and Chittoor and Annamayya districts are also on alert. Telangana on Oct 28: red alert for Mulugu, Bhadradri Kothagudem and Khammam; orange for 5 districts; yellow for 8. Hyderabad: no IMD alert, light rain.
